criteria.requirement: Implement tabulate.accessibility.accessible_html(data,headers=(),*,caption=None,table_id=None,row_headers=False,**options). Render via safe html format, add escaped caption/optional quoted id, scope=col to real column header th elements and optional scope=row to the first cell of each body row. Preserve other cells, alignment and data escaping; never convert escaped user markup into actual tags. Reject overriding tablefmt, nonboolean row_headers and invalid caption/id values before rendering. Keep old html/unsafehtml output unchanged and do not alter tabulate public signature.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
